name: Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Kunshan, China, Kunshan Dongwei Technology Co.,Ltd. is primarily engaged in the innovation, production, and distribution of machinery for printed circuit board (PCB) plating across the Chinese market. The company's diverse portfolio extends to include equipment for general metal plating, plastic plating, anodizing lines, and barrel plating, in addition to specialized PCB wet processing systems and associated components. Beyond its product offerings, Dongwei Technology provides extensive technical assistance for surface treatment engineering, encompassing expert consultation, practical application training, and ongoing technical support services.
